title: The Seven Poor Travellers
author: Charles Dickens

authorInfo.bio: Charles Dickens was an English novelist and journalist whose memorable characters brought Victorian society to life. His stories combine humour, sympathy and criticism of poverty and injustice. His works include Oliver Twist, David Copperfield, Bleak House and Great Expectations.

description: "The Seven Poor Travellers" by Charles Dickens is a collection of Christmas-themed tales written during the late 19th century (Victorian era). The book weaves together the experiences of a narrator, who encounters six travellers in Rochester looking for shelter, exploring themes of generosity and compassion during the Christmas season.
